description: The plot illustrates how three accuracy-related series vary with “Initial Confidence,” showing “Final Accuracy,” “Initial Accuracy,” and “Δ Accuracy” at a set of discrete confidence values with vertical error bars. The x-axis is labeled “Initial Confidence,” uses a linear scale, and spans from 0.71 to 1.00; tick labels are shown at irregularly spaced numeric values (0.71, 0.73, 0.79, 0.82, 0.83, 0.85, 0.86, 0.87, 0.90, 0.91, 0.92, 0.93, 0.94, 0.95, 0.96, 0.97, 0.98, 0.99, 1.00). The y-axis is labeled “Accuracy,” uses a linear scale, and ranges from 0.0 to 1.0 with evenly spaced tick marks at 0.2 intervals. The “Final Accuracy” series is drawn as a blue solid line with circular markers and blue error bars; it starts near 0.90 at 0.71, dips to about 0.73 at 0.73, reaches about 1.00 at 0.79, stays around the high 0.8s to mid 0.9s through most intermediate x-values (e.g., about 0.89–0.90 at 0.85–0.87), hits about 1.00 again at 0.91 and 0.96, and ends near 0.98 at 1.00. The “Δ Accuracy” series is an orange dashed line with diamond markers and orange error bars; it is about 0.36 at 0.71, drops to around 0.10 at 0.73 and about 0.08 at 0.79, rises to roughly 0.24–0.28 at 0.82–0.83, is about 0.11–0.16 at 0.85–0.86, peaks near 0.46 at 0.87, falls to about 0.04 at 0.90, rises again to around 0.41 at 0.91 and about 0.44 at 0.93, and finishes near 0.08 at 1.00. The “Initial Accuracy” series is a green dash-dot line with square markers and green error bars; it begins around 0.55 at 0.71 and about 0.63 at 0.73, increases to roughly 0.92 at 0.79, declines to about 0.70 at 0.82 and about 0.64 at 0.83, rises to around 0.78 at 0.85, drops to about 0.45 at 0.87, increases to about 0.83 at 0.90, fluctuates between roughly 0.46 and 0.83 across 0.91–0.99 (e.g., about 0.46 at 0.93 and about 0.83 at 0.95), and ends near 0.90 at 1.00.
